{{Quote|He is the Separatists' Techno Union Foreman, as well as a combat engineer. A brilliant strategist. And extremely dangerous&mdash;an expert at fighting machines, and a master of defense technologies. He is also an expert at escape.|[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]|<ref name="bf5" />}}
'''Wat Tambor''' was a [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skako/Legends|Skako]]. He was the [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and Executive of [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]], and also held the title of "[[Emir/Legends|Emir]]." Beginning his career as the Techno Union [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], Tambor shot up through the ranks of the Union, quickly becoming Foreman. He agreed to help fund and supply [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] separatist government, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and when [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]] broke out between the Separatists and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Tambor began devising new ways to gain a technological advantage.

In effort of multiple plots, including [[Battle of Ryloth (disambiguation)|invading]] the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], and manufacturing [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|C-B3 cortosis battle droids]], Tambor was able to make a concerted contribution to the war effort. In the waning stages of the war, Tambor set up shop on [[Xagobah/Legends|Xagobah]], where he was assailed by both Republic forces and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. He was rescued by the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], and united with the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he was called back to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Skako, where he was sent on a spiritual journey by the [[Elders (Skakoan)|Elders]] of the [[Power Mounds of the Elders|Power Mounds]]. During his journey, he saw his future, and eventually went to the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] to meet it. There, he was [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|slain]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], along with the other members of the Council, concurrent with the declaration of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Born on [[Skako/Legends|Skako]] into the [[Crimlin clan]], Tambor spent little time on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] as a youth, as he traveled to [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] to pursue a career in industry and technology.<ref name="cswe" /> Tambor was a rarity, as most [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoans]] never left their homeworld.<ref name="cod" /> Metalorn's atmosphere was inhospitable to Skakoans, and as a result Tambor was forced to develop a full-body suit that mimicked the atmosphere of Skako.<ref name="cswe" /> He would also spend considerable time at his private estate on [[Foundry/Legends|Foundry]].<ref name="sf14412">{{InsiderCite|67|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:4:12 Edition}}</ref> While on Metalorn, Tambor became a superb combat engineer.<ref name="cswe" /> At some stage, he ascended to the position of [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]],<ref name="cod" /> with the aid of [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]].<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> Tambor returned the favor by allowing him to use Hypori as a training ground and supplied training guards for both the Sun Guards Plagueis employed and his new apprentice.

Following the [[Dorvalla Incident|Incident at Dorvalla]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] proposed that the Republic instigate the taxation of trade routes. Tambor, knowing that this would damage the Union, was not in favor of the motion, and was in luck when [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] proposed that the matter be resolved at a [[Eriadu Trade Summit|Trade Summit]] on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. However, things went awry at the summit, with several influential figures in the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] being assassinated. The taxation bill went on to be passed in the Senate.<ref name="cod" />

===Techno Union Foreman and Executive of Baktoid===
Over the next decade, Tambor ascended to the role of [[Foreman/Legends|Techno Union Foreman]],<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> and also became the Executive of Baktoid Armor Workshop.<ref name="tpm">{{Film|I}}</ref> As Techno Union Foreman, Tambor was also charged with overseeing [[Haor Chall Engineering/Legends|Haor Chall Engineering]], and supervising [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]] and [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]] development [[Laboratory/Legends|labs]].<ref name="cswe" /> Tambor was the most well known associate of the Federation's leader and Viceroy [[Nute Gunray]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Baktoid saw a setback when their biggest customer, the Trade Federation, used its [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invade]] the peaceful [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Naboo.<ref name="tpm" /><ref name="cswe" /> When Republic officials learned this, they went about partially disarming the Federation, which also cut Baktoid's legs out from under them.<ref name="hn46">[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 46|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #46]]</ref>

Tambor, however, followed his partner Viceroy Gunray of the Trade Federation in joining [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] new [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Dooku needed an [[Army/Legends|army]] with which to decimate the Republic, and Tambor was able to oblige. However, the possible consequences of building an army in plain sight of the Republic would be risky, and so Tambor closed an array of [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Baktoid factories, citing revenue losses, and began producing weaponry and droids in secret [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] factories,<ref name="hn46" /> most notably on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="aotc" /> Tambor was able to satiate disgruntled shareholders with press releases, but his ploy did not fool everyone. Senator [[Lanus Wrede]] correctly hypothesized that Tambor was building droids in secret, but his opinions were dismissed by the media, due to the fact that there was supposedly no market in the Outer Rim. Republic investigations into the allegation also yielded no results, and shortly after, Wrede "committed suicide", although the accuracy of his claims pointed to foul play on the part of Tambor.<ref name="hn46" />

When Senator [[Rodd]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Groodo]], and the designer [[Hurlo Holowan]] conspired to destroy [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] with the ''[[Sun Runner]]'', an ancient [[Starship/Legends|ship]] imbued with the strength of [[power gem]]s, Tambor had a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] placed on their heads, seeking vengeance against those who would endanger his investments in the [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]]. He offered the bounty, requesting that the quarry be delivered dead, to [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]], who accepted.<ref name="swa4">''[[Star Wars Adventures 4: Jango Fett vs. the Razor Eaters]]''</ref><ref name="Star Wars Adventures 5: The Shape-Shifter Strikes">''[[Star Wars Adventures 5: The Shape-Shifter Strikes]]''</ref> Unbeknownst to Tambor, Dooku had also placed a bounty on the trio, with the intent of bringing them in alive, since he was impressed with the concept of their ''Sun Runner'' scheme and the ingenuity, ambition, talent, and secrecy they demonstrated. The Foreman was contacted by the Count, and Dooku convinced the Skakoan to call off the debt. Rodd, Groodo, and Holowan were all eventually brought in by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="swa6">''[[Star Wars Adventures 6: The Warlords of Balmorra]]''</ref>

In spite of his involvement with the Confederacy, Tambor still kept his hand in Republic politics, and made a token appearance at a [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]] fundraiser on [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]]. Tambor could not actually consume the foods served there, but felt the need to be seen as sympathetic to the disenfranchised of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Other secret members of the CIS in attendance were [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] and [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], as well as now-Supreme Chancellor Palpatine. The latter was in fact Darth Sidious, Dooku's [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], though Tambor was not aware of this. Realizing that Dooku would reveal the Confederacy to the galaxy in the near future, Tambor reinforced the Union factory at [[Foerost/Legends|Foerost]] with a security force of forty thousand [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], since the installation would be vulnerable in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. In exchange for the seemingly copious amounts of battle droids, Tambor allowed government officials to continue their regular inspections of the facilities.<ref name="hn53">[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 53|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #53]]</ref>

[[File:WatTambor-AOTC.png|thumb|right|300px|Wat Tambor pledges the Techno Union's support to the Confederacy of Independent Systems.]]

===Clone Wars===
====Entering the war====
{{Quote|With these new battle droids we built for you, you'll have the finest army in the galaxy.|Tambor to Dooku|<ref name="aotc" />}}
Tambor met with the other leaders of the Separatist Council on Geonosis to re-pledge their allegiance to Dooku. While there, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was caught sneaking around the Baktoid factories, and soon after, Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] Anakin Skywalker were caught in the same act. The trio were sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]], but were rescued by a team of Jedi led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. The Jedi were soon followed by a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|large Republic army]], the size of which the Separatists had never predicted. After a long and bloody [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]], the CIS was routed. Tambor was able to escape, but Baktoid had now lost one of its key secret factories.<ref name="aotc" /> Tambor became a [[General/Legends|general]] in the CIS Droid Army.<ref name="ForcesofDark">''[[The Clone Wars: Forces of Darkness]]''</ref>

====Conspiracy with Oviedo====
{{Quote|You imbecile, Tambor&mdash;you weren't supposed to leave any witnesses!''"<br />"''I won't.|Lorca Oviedo and Wat Tambor|<ref name="hb">{{Tales|22|Honor Bound}}</ref>}}
[[File:Oviedo_Tambor.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Lorca Oviedo converses with a hologram of Wat Tambor on Asturias.]]
Tambor sought to wreak his revenge, not by retaliating with military strength, but by sabotaging Republic munitions. He was able to convince [[Director General]] [[Lorca Oviedo]] of [[Oviedo Engineering]], a munitions manufacturer, to meet with him on the remote and dangerous world of [[Asturias]] to discuss a business proposition. Oviedo was always accompanied by a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] escort, so to maintain the secrecy of the mission, Tambor ambushed the Director while he was in transit from [[Aviles Prime]], ensuring the safety of the Director while doing maximum damage to his escort. Oviedo was prepared for this, and was able to escape harm. His ship was able to land on Asturias with a minimum of fuss, despite being hit, but Tambor's droids stormed in, executing the entire crew. While Oviedo was escorted away to the rendezvous, several of the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] escorting the director managed to crash land on Asturias and escape the wreckage of their ship.<ref name="hb" />

Tambor himself was not in attendance, but rather communicated via a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. He felt that Oviedo's poor standing in the Senate might incriminate him by association, and at any rate, the planet's climate would not have agreed with his Skakoan temperament. He discussed with Oviedo the idea of sabotaging Republic supplies and munitions, which would both be profitable for Oviedo and beneficial to the CIS. Tambor also explained the need for the recent violent events, believing that an "assassination attempt" would effectively give Oviedo clemency in the eyes of the Senate. However, the clone commando escort had overheard the conversation, and were able to extract Oviedo, but sustained heavy losses in the process. Tambor ordered his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to kill Oviedo should he be on the brink of escape, but they failed. Shortly after Oviedo had returned to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he passed away before he could relate the story.<ref name="hb" />

====Gha Nachkt====
{{Quote|I have made sure that the magistrate has purchased the ''special droid'' that you arranged. If you tune into the frequency now, you will see that it is transmitting.''"<br />"''Very good, Gha Nachkt. The funds have been forwarded to your account.|[[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]] and Wat Tambor|<ref name="Discount">''[[The Clone Wars: Discount]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Tambor_Covetous.png|thumb|right|120px|Emir Tambor, invader of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]]]
Tambor chose to move against fellow Councilman Argente, the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]]. The Skakoan knew that Argente was suspicious of his movements, and Tambor used the [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar's]] mistrust to his own advantage. Knowing that Argente would seek out a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] droid to utilize against Tambor from the dealer [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]], Tambor paid Nachkt to sell a spy [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|droid]] to the Koorivar. As Tambor had predicted, Argente contacted Nachkt, and the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] dealer dutifully sold Tambor's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] to Argente. Once the Koorivar had the droid, Nachkt contacted Tambor, and the Skakoan transmitted the dealer's [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|reward]] to him. Tambor tuned into the droid's frequency, allowing the Foreman to directly spy on Argente and track his movements across the galaxy.<ref name="Discount" />

====Conqueror of worlds====
{{Quote|Droid! Is Ryloth one of our targeted worlds?''"<br />"''Yes, Emir. Based on resources, accessibility, political influence, and overall strategic value, it is currently ranked as number seventy-nine.''"<br />"''Mobilize our troops. We are moving it to number one.|Wat Tambor and TA-175|<ref name="Covetous">''[[The Clone Wars: Covetous]]''</ref>}}
Tambor later took the title of [[Emir/Legends|Emir]].<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode019.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref> As Tambor tracked Argente's movements, the Koorivar traveled to the Outer Rim planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] to meet with [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] broker [[Artruk]], whom Argente had hired to conceal treasures in his possession. Upon noticing the treasures,<ref name="Covetous" /> Tambor ordered his personal [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]], [[TA-175/Legends|TA-175]],<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode021.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> to move Ryloth to the highest priority for a Confederate invasion.<ref name="Covetous" /> Tambor soon invaded Ryloth, starving and subjugating the Twi'lek population to a harsh rule. The Skakoan [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] Ryloth, placing [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]] in charge of the Confederate [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]],<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref> while Tambor made headquarters for himself in Ryloth's capital city, [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]].<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> Tambor also placed tactical droid [[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]]<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode020.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref> in charge of the Confederate [[Proton cannon/Legends|proton cannons]] stationed in the city of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]].<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth">{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref>

[[File:Windu_corners_Tambor.png|thumb|left|250px|Mace Windu corners Tambor on Ryloth.]]
However, the Republic soon launched a plan to [[Battle of Ryloth (disambiguation)|invade and liberate the planet]]. After [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan, [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] Ahsoka Tano, eliminated the Confederate blockade around Ryloth, [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Generals]] Mace Windu and Obi-Wan Kenobi were able to move in with their [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|transports]].<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> Kenobi and [[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]] eliminated the cannons and also destroyed TX-20, and the Republic invasion forces were able to land.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> Tambor was not amused with Tuuk's<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> and TX-20's respective failures,<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> as he would be forced to take the blame for their faults.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

In a holographic conference with Tambor, Count Dooku, displeased with the Emir's weakening hold on Ryloth, ordered him to salvage what he could of the Twi'lek treasures on the planet and retreat before Windu arrived with his forces in Lessu. Dooku also ordered Tambor to liquidate whatever he could of Ryloth, as the massacre would show the galaxy the "cost" of a Republic victory. To accomplish this, Tambor dispatched a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]]<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />&mdash;and, at TA-175's recommendation, an army of ground forces<ref name="Ryloth: Republic Defender">{{TCWA|Republic Defender}} {{C|"Hasbro Biggest Battles: Ryloth" promotion}}</ref>&mdash;to begin destroying several Twi'lek villages in the area. However, Windu soon enlisted the help of the Twi'lek leader [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] and Ryloth's [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|resistance]] against the Confederate oppression. Tambor decided to wait for the last of several [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]] hauling the treasures, despite Dooku's order to retreat and bomb Lessu. TA-175, too impatient to wait for his master, departed aboard Tambor's [[Wat Tambor's Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], and the Skakoan was left stranded just as the Republic forces arrived in the city. Windu cornered Tambor; however, Dooku was intent on eliminating Lessu, even with Tambor's life in jeopardy. The Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] ordered TA-175 to continue with the bombers' attack, but the intervention of Skywalker and Tano in their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|fighters]] prevented the destruction of Lessu. Tambor surrendered and was taken into Republic custody.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

====Cortosis battle droid plot====
Sometime after the [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|Confederate-Republic peace initiative]], Wat Tambor was no longer in Republic custody. Tambor sought new ways to gain an advantage against the Republic in his new role as Confederate [[Combat engineer (Techno Union)/Legends|combat engineer]],<ref name="sf14412" /> and as a result, his Techno Union engineers on Metalorn devised the [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|C-B3 cortosis battle droid]], a modified version of the [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] that was resistant to [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] attacks. Tambor obtained the required cortosis from [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], and the droids made their [[Coruscant Insurrection|combat debut]] on the capital of the Republic, led by none other than Count Dooku. Though Dooku was able to retrieve an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Holocron/Legends|artifact]] from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], the droids were driven off by Anakin Skywalker<ref name="nda">''[[Star Wars: The New Droid Army]]''</ref> and Republic officer [[Rom Mohc]].<ref name="dfs">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref>

When Tambor learned that the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] was planning to send Skywalker to destroy the C-B3 factory on Metalorn, he began to fear for both his own life and the life of his project. He hired the bounty hunter [[Vandalor]] as his personal bodyguard, but his forces were unable to stop Skywalker's sabotage mission; Vandalor was killed by Skywalker and Tambor was arrested. With the factory destroyed, the idea of integrating cortosis into battle droids would go undeveloped and unused for the remainder of the war.<ref name="nda" /> Tambor was [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] on [[Delrian/Legends|Delrian]], but the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] were privy to the layouts of the facility he was kept in. Two Skakoan members of Tambor's staff, along with the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Changeling/Legends|changeling]] [[Nuri]], were granted a visit to the Foreman's cell. Upon entry, the Skakoans decompressed their pressure cells, blowing themselves up and allowing Nuri to [[Mission to Delrian|ferry Tambor to safety]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> He returned to his home in the Foundry [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Denus]] shortly afterward, where he recuperated in a [[hyperbaric recharge globe]] in order to heal his wounds from the ordeal.<ref name="sf14412" />

Upon his recovery, Tambor publicly decried [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat's]] attempted robbery of [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] technology. He also championed the defensive capabilities of CIS droids during the crisis.<ref name="sf14701">{{InsiderCite|68|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:7:01 Edition}}</ref> Tambor would once again face the press about the Republic's hiring of over 125 [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] scientists in an attempt to gain a technological advantage over the CIS. Tambor claimed, essentially, that it was data that would win the war, rather than advanced technology.<ref name="sf15015">{{InsiderCite|73|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:01:15 Edition}}</ref>

====Zygerria====
Tambor and [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], the leader of the Commerce Guild, were invited by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]] to [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]], which had recently allied itself with the Confederacy. An auction was to be held on the planet, in which the entire population of the [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togrutan]] colony was to be sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. On arrival, Tambor told the Queen that he welcomed their new partnership, and she promised that she would not disappoint him. The auction began, but the Queen soon interrupted it to show the captured Kenobi to the crowd. Tambor was frightened by Kenobi's presence there, as he knew what the Jedi were capable of, despite the Queen's assurance that there was nothing to worry about. However, Skywalker was present, disguised as a slaver. When the Queen ordered Skywalker to whip Kenobi, Skywalker instead attacked Kenobi's guards, supported by his Padawan, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]]. Tambor's worries were confirmed, and he and Mai fled the planet.<ref name="Auction of a Million Souls">[[The Clone Wars 4|''The Clone Wars'' 4]]</ref>

Tambor was eventually captured by the Republic again, being held in their [[Republic military base|military base]].<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref> Tambor later escaped from Republic captivity.<ref name="rots">{{Film|III}}</ref> When a downed Confederate [[Transport/Legends|transport]] on the Techno Union world of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] fell prey to Republic [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]], Tambor moved to [[Battle of Mustafar (Clone Wars)|obliterate]] the slicing team and their clone reinforcements under the command of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]]. Moving to destroy the information on the transport's [[Computer/Legends|computers]] before the Republic could access it, Tambor sent forth an army of droids fresh from Mustafar's foundries to besiege the Republic force, advancing his forces from two directions to attack the Republic's canyon position. Despite initially breaking through the clone defenses, Tambor was unable to prevent the slicers from retrieving the data. Nevertheless, Tambor continued to work against the Republic by operating with a spy among the Republic forces. When his agent was apprehended and incarcerated in the Republic's command center, Tambor dispatched his forces to liberate the prisoner but was unable to free him. As Tambor threatened several neighboring systems, he launched a massive counterattack on the Republic forces, which drew him into a trap at the canyon. While Tambor deployed battle droids and droid starfighters to destroy the Republic's command center, the Republic effectively dispatched them with tower-mounted blaster turrets. The clones were able to destroy a ''Hyena''-class bomber that Tambor sent to attack them, escaping before Tambor could stop them.<ref name="CWA: Republic Defender">{{TCWA|Republic Defender}}</ref>

Tambor also sought to [[Battle of Orto Plutonia (Tambor and Ventress)|claim]] the icy world [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]] with TA-175 and a detachment of battle droids. However, a Jedi Knight thwarted Tambor's efforts to seize an Orto Plutonian [[Talz village/Legends|Talz village]], and Tambor was forced to retreat. Tambor also led the Techno Union's armies to [[Battle of Iego|invade]] the planet [[Iego/Legends|Iego]],<ref name="CWA: Card Commander">{{TCWA|Card Commander}}</ref> where the Separatists had once maintained a base.<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref> After being defeated by the same Jedi Knight who had been the cause of his latest losses, Tambor left his tactical droids in charge of the battle and escaped to a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] in the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]]. Using a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]] that had been placed on Tambor, the Jedi Knight pursued the Techno Union Foreman and caused his frigate to crash on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], where Tambor surrounded himself with forces led by TA-175. As the Jedi Knight [[Battle of Kessel (Wat Tambor)|battled]] through Tambor's forces to arrest the Techno Union Foreman, Tambor sent a squad of [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] into battle, but they were defeated as Tambor made his last stand against the Jedi.<ref name="CWA: Card Commander" />

====Operations on Xagobah====
[[File:TamborGrievous.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Wat Tambor and General Grievous, during their time on Xagobah.]]
In the later stages of the war, Tambor helped the Confederacy fortify their Outer Rim holdings. He travelled to [[Xagobah/Legends|Xagobah]], which was the location of a [[Mazariyan|large fortress]] that he had designed. While there, he lorded an unofficial rule over the [[Xamster/Legends|Xamsters]], and wreaked havoc on the flora and [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] of the planet, making the area around the citadel a natural deathtrap. His citadel was virtually impervious, due to the deadly mutated fungus that fed off a "heart" in the citadel's core. This made it a perfect staging ground for Confederate forces, and was also ideal for his own protection. The Republic, however, was not deterred, and dispatched Jedi General [[Glynn-Beti]] and her Padawan [[Ulu Ulix]],<ref name="bf5" /> along with General Skywalker,<ref name="bf6">''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]''</ref> with a sizable force of clone troopers to breach Tambor's defenses. The attack, however, quickly transformed into a siege. The Republic dug in and battered away at the citadel, while Tambor continually sent out squads of droids to break enemy lines.<ref name="bf5" />

Unbeknown to Tambor or the Jedi, high ranking officials in the Senate had placed bounties on the heads of the Separatist Council. Jabba Desilijic Tiure, with whom Tambor had dealings several years prior, acted as a fence for these bounties, and assigned Tambor's head to the young clone [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. It was Fett's first genuine bounty, and he was more than willing to accept, despite the danger and improbability of his success. While Fett made his way to the fortress, Tambor tried to break the siege by having a substantial [[ramship]] piloted towards the Republic forces, but his gambit failed when the young bounty hunter destroyed the ship. Eventually, Fett made his way into the citadel, and after fighting off several of Tambor's guards, came face to face with the Foreman in the citadel's core.<ref name="bf5" />

In spite of his unwieldy appearance, Tambor was more than able to defend himself. Using a weapon built into his suit, he fired rays of energy at the young Fett, who dodged and returned fire. Tambor quickly evaded Fett's fire, while the tentacles of the citadel's living "heart" attempted to subdue the young clone. The duel between the two raged on for a while until Tambor called in the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] General Grievous. Fett, who had hidden from Tambor's repeated attacks, activated a [[Multispectrum disguise suite|holoshroud]] built-in to his suit, giving him the appearance of the notorious bounty hunter [[Durge/Legends|Durge]]. This failed to help Fett, since Grievous had no love for the hulking [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]], and the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general had his troops open fire. Fett fled, with his holoshroud rendered useless, but Grievous caught up with him and subdued him. Before the general could land a killing blow, Fett touched some of the citadel's fungi, paralyzing him and rendering him, to the naked eye, dead. With his citadel crumbling around him, Tambor directed his concerns toward evacuation.<ref name="bf5" /> While the Foreman was able to leave safely, he was pursued once again by Fett in space, but this time Tambor's retreat was successfully covered by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="bf6" />

[[File:TamborBail.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Wat Tambor welcomes Viceroy Bail Organa to Metalorn.]]

====Dealings with Bail Organa====
{{Quote|You'll ''pay'' for this, Organa!|Wat Tambor|<ref name="bo">{{CWACite|5|Bailed Out}}</ref>}}
On Metalorn, Tambor's troops had captured Jedi Master [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], and in turn imprisoned her in the maximum security section of Metalorn's [[Unreal City/Legends|Unreal City]]. Shortly thereafter, [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] contacted Tambor, citing interest in applying Metalorn's infrastructure template to his homeworld. Meeting with Organa and his aides on Metalorn, he began giving the Viceroy a tour of the planet, spooling off facts and statistics about the economy of the system. Organa, however, expressed an interest in the prison facilities, which Tambor was only too happy to show off. Upon entry, however, Organa was able to pass a lightsaber to the captive Ti, allowing her to [[Mission to Metalorn (Bail Organa)|escape]]. Though Tambor called in droids to stop Ti and the Alderaanians, his efforts failed, and his adversaries escaped. As Organa's [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] shot away from Metalorn, Tambor stood in a fit of rage, swearing revenge.<ref name="bo" />

====Quest for the Sacred Eye of the Albino Cyclops====
[[File:Wat_tambor_unmasked.jpg|thumb|right|170px|Wat Tambor is stripped of his pressure mask.]]
{{Quote|My mind lattice is calibrated for the quickening&hellip;|Wat Tambor|<ref name="ac" />}}
At some stage after the incident on Metalorn, Tambor once again encountered Skywalker, this time losing his right eye to the "Hero With No Fear". Following this, Tambor was summoned to the Power Mounds on Skako, a holy place where the Elders read from the [[Book of the Boolmide]]. It was an honor reserved for few, and Tambor willingly accepted the call. Due to the loss of his eye, he was dispatched on a mission to retrieve the [[Eye of the Albino Cyclops]], though he was warned not to take it for his own benefit. [[Clongor]], the chief Elder, gave Tambor several of the sacred symbols from the book, and sent him on his way.<ref name="ac" />

Upon reaching the [[Gates of Grontessiant]], where the [[Albino Cyclops]] was believed to reside, Tambor was stripped bare of his pressure suit and set upon by the [[Lord Being of the Swirblies]]. He encountered the Albino Cyclops, and imbued himself with the fabled eye, which allowed him to see his future that somehow involved the Techno Union world of Mustafar. The Elders sought to send him there, but they would soon be overruled by Confederate officials.<ref name="ac" />

===Death===
{{Quote|Please, I'll give you anything. Anything you want!|Wat Tambor's final words|<ref name="ROTSnovel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of The Sith'' novelization]]</ref>}}
[[File:Anakinwat3tf.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Wat Tambor is killed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].]]
Grievous reunited Tambor with the rest of the Separatist Council, and sent them to the safe-world of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] for protection. Following his unsuccessful [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|raid]] on Coruscant, however, the cyborg general relocated the Council to Mustafar, fulfilling the Albino Eye's prophecy. The move proved canny, since the Republic [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|attacked]] and conquered Utapau shortly after the Council's departure. During the battle, Grievous was killed by Obi-Wan Kenobi, and since Dooku had perished over Coruscant, the Council was in control of the Confederacy. Nute Gunray, as head of the council, became the new Head of State, but the Council's "rule" would be short-lived.<ref name="rots" />

Darth Sidious, who was now [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]], betrayed the Council, telling the Council members that they were to await the delivery of a "reward" for their efforts. The reward was in fact [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|assassination]], and was delivered personally by Sidious' new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], Darth Vader. Tambor, along with [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]], fled into the conference room away from Vader to hide. Vader&mdash;who as Anakin Skywalker had once captured Tambor&mdash;systematically executed the Council members. Before Haako could enter the room, he was cleaved through by Vader's lightsaber. After Vader located and cornered Tambor, Tambor pleaded for mercy, but his cries fell on deaf ears. Vader impaled Tambor through the chest without a second thought and moved on, eventually killing all present and destroying the Confederacy of Independent Systems.<ref name="ROTSnovel" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Wat_14-4-12.jpg|thumb|right|210px|Wat Tambor]]
{{Quote|It appears a surrender is unnecessary. We will all perish for the ''glory'' of the Separatist Alliance.|Wat Tambor to Mace Windu, as Separatist bombers approach|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />}}
Tambor was very proud of his accomplishments. He had the utmost faith in the systems he had devised for Metalorn<ref name="bo" /> and Xagobah,<ref name="bf5" /> and would not shy away from advertising their advantages. He apparently had no care for the common people, and would constantly ignore their needs for the benefit of his productions. He also hoped that the system he had set up on Metalorn would be echoed by other worlds when the Confederacy had taken control of the galaxy. Unfortunately for Tambor, he would fail to see that event transpire.<ref name="bo" />

While he was renowned as a master strategist, Tambor was captured and taken into Republic custody several times.<ref name="sf14412" /><ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> Despite his bulky pressure-suit, he was also a skilled combatant, able to hold his own against certain assailants. He understood the value of security, and was usually surrounded with bodyguards, although, should they fail, he could always rely on hidden weapons built into his suit.<ref name="bf5" />

Tambor also valued his politically clean record. He always covered his tracks, and constantly tried to avoid making himself a target. Even after the Battle of Geonosis, Tambor hoped to stay politically clean, though he would eventually fail.<ref name="hb" /> Tambor was a very religious Skakoan, being one of the few to actually ascend to the Power Mounds.<ref name="ac" /> Despite this, he attempted to avoid his fate on Mustafar, though he failed, this time with fatal consequences.<ref name="rots" />

Tambor was skilled in several languages, able to read and write in both [[Binary/Legends|Binary]] and [[Skakoform]], and well as being able to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Sluissese]], [[Verpine (language)|Verpine]], Binary and [[Skakoverbal/Legends|Skakoverbal]].<ref name="GMR10">{{GamerCite|10|Galactic Power Brokers}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TechnoBaron.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept art by Michael Murnane.]]
{{Quote|Wat Tambor has the quality of Flash Gordon and art deco, a character formed of simple shapes that relate to each other.|[[Michael Murnane]], concept artist for ''Attack of the Clones''|<ref name="Art of AOTC">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>}}
Wat Tambor was played by [[Ben Burtt]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="TCWS1">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]] ("Liberty on Ryloth" - Featurette)</ref> In the [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|video game adaption of ''Revenge of the Sith'']], Tambor was played by voice-actor [[David W. Collins]]. In the [[2008]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, he was portrayed by voice-actor [[Matthew Wood]], who also voiced General Grievous, Poggle The Lesser, the battle droids and many others throughout the series.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth Ep Guide" /><ref name="Innocents of Ryloth Ep Guide" /><ref name="Liberty on Ryloth Ep Guide" />

Though Tambor was developed for ''Attack of the Clones'', he first appeared in [[James Luceno]]'s ''[[Cloak of Deception]]''. This was due to the fact that Luceno was privy to much of the ''Clones'' pre-production material, and was able to write it into his book, where suitable. Tambor was also written into the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News web series]] by [[Paul Ens]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]].

Tambor's design was developed by concept artist Michael Murnane, who created an art deco look for the character that incorporated simple shapes and lines. In his film appearance, Tambor was entirely computer-generated.<ref name="db" />

A line of dialogue originally belonging to [[Poggle the Lesser]] concerning the battle droids was later given to Wat Tambor himself, explaining that the [[Techno Union]] were the builders of most of the new droid army seen in Episode II.<ref name="db" />

In the initial brainstorming sessions for [[Star Wars: Clone Wars]], the artists at the Cartoon Network wanted Tambor to figure as a villain. That character, however, was already slated for [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|another Clone Wars-project]], so [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] and the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] were instead featured.<ref name="DB-Muunilinst">{{DB|location|muunilinst|Muunilinst}}</ref>

In the comic story ''[[Wat Tambor and the Quest for the Sacred Eye of the Albino Cyclops]]'', his eyes are black. However, in the cover of the same comic, his only eye is shown as brown.<ref name="ac" /> A Skakoan that looks similar to Tambor appears in the comic ''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]'', but this character has not been confirmed to be him.<ref name="deadly hands">''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''</ref>

In [[2008]], ''Star Wars'' sound designer [[Ben Burtt]] listed Wat Tambor as his "favorite Star Wars robot."<ref name="SWArchive-WALL·E Creators List Fave Robots">{{SWArchive|url=fans/rocks/news20080710.html|text=WALL·E Creators List Fave Robots}}</ref>
